_comment: TC-34 (readme-refresh-trackb-and-followon-2026-09-01), SW-F fix. The durable, in-repo, git-tracked source of truth for the /readme-refresh (S-120) README structure -- previously only lived in a 1.8MB gitignored plan file. required_sections and check_function_count are BOTH independently, mechanically verified against the real code (readme_refresh_checks.py) by scripts/ci/checks/check_readme_template_contract_parity.py -- never hand-edit either field without also re-running that check; it will fail loudly if this file drifts from the code, or if the code drifts from this file.

optional_sections.name: Additional Examples
optional_sections.rule: vacuously satisfied when absent -- required only when a product has enough real snippets to justify a dedicated section (a content-quality judgment call, not mechanically enforced). cells/cpp is the one portfolio product that legitimately has no such section.

section_order: required_sections lists the canonical order; Additional Examples, when present, sits between Quick Start and API Reference.

check_function_count.note: This number drifts upward as missions land real new checks -- the parity check re-greps the real count on every run rather than trusting this file; a mismatch here is a doc-drift finding, not a code defect.
